title: Search state gate bound
statement: Let $D$ be a family of directed acyclic circuits, with the circuit at index $j$ having $n+j$ inputs, and let $S,M$ be natural numbers. Suppose every index $j$ with $1\le j\le M$ has circuit size at most $S$. Then, for every $j\le M$, the gate list in the state after $j$ search steps has length at most $1+j(S+1)$.
